whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Satvik Yoga Kendra,

I noticed your yoga studio has a perfect 5.0★ rating in Kankarbagh, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new class inquiries and batch timings.

Maine aapke yoga studio ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, morning/evening batch timings, aur class highlights integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://satvik-yoga-kendra.arclane.app

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Satvik Yoga Kendra team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking and batch timings for your Kankarbagh center. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact classes aur timings setup karke live kar sakte hain."
